name: tree-authored-identity-kind-resolution
body: tree_authored_identity now reads graph.jsonl and the plan store twice (once via code_universes_from_export, once via code_kinds_from_export), and a FQN absent from both the export and the plan store's planned_node kind still falls back to module, so a stale or partial export could keep losing non-module operation rows. Limits: two passes over the export, and a module fallback for FQNs with no recorded kind. Upgrade: fold the two passes into one if the tree digest becomes hot on large repos, and tighten the fallback when a non-module kind must survive a partial export.
